mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.name, r.description, r.address, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(rv.rating), 1), 0) AS averageRating, COUNT(rv.id) AS reviewCount
FROM restaurant r
LEFT JOIN review rv ON r.id = rv.restaurant_id
WHERE r.status = 1 AND r.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY r.id, r.name, r.description, r.address, r.created_at
ORDER BY averageRating DESC, r.id DESC
ORDER BY reviewCount DESC, r.id DESC
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
